regime.label: Risk-Off
regime.description: VIX 28.5, approaching panic zone. Dow enters correction (-10.2%). Nasdaq -12.1%. Five consecutive weekly losses. SPX momentum score collapsed to 0.25. Consumer sentiment plunges to Dec 2025 lows. OECD slashes growth. Risk-off deepening.

risks.label: Iran-US Strait of Hormuz Standoff
risks.impact: Oil supply disruption (~20% global), Brent above $100, potential $130+ on escalation, stagflation, S&P -10-15%
risks.catalyst: April 6 deadline approaching. Iran deal probability dropped to 22%. No concrete progress. Brent entrenched above $100.
risks.detail: Oil supply disruption (~20% global), Brent above $100, potential $130+ on escalation, stagflation, S&P -10-15%

risks.label: Stagflation Risk
risks.impact: Consumer squeeze from $100+ oil, Fed paralysis (50/50 cut odds), margin compression, yield curve steepening
risks.catalyst: Core PCE at 2.8% (above consensus). Michigan inflation expectations surged 3.4% to 3.8%. OECD warns of higher global inflation from energy prices. 30Y yield approaching 5%.
risks.detail: Consumer squeeze from $100+ oil, Fed paralysis (50/50 cut odds), margin compression, yield curve steepening

risks.label: Broad Market Correction
risks.impact: Nasdaq -10.3% from peak, high-PE tech under pressure from rising yields, VIX at 27.4
risks.catalyst: Consumer sentiment collapse, OECD downgrade, hot Core PCE, ISM Manufacturing (Apr 1) and NFP (Apr 3) next.
risks.detail: Dow joins Nasdaq in correction territory. S&P 500 -8.8% from peak, 1.2% from correction. Russell -11.5%. 5 consecutive weekly losses. VIX 28.5 approaching panic.

risks.label: US Recession 2026
risks.impact: Earnings downturn, credit tightening, equity bear market
risks.catalyst: Prediction market odds at 18% (+3pp weekly). Michigan consumer expectations plunged 14%. OECD growth downgrade. Next catalyst: ISM Manufacturing (Apr 1) and NFP (Apr 3).
risks.detail: Earnings downturn, credit tightening, equity bear market

risks.label: Global Trade Restructuring
risks.impact: Supply chain inflation sticky, winners (Vietnam, India, Mexico) vs losers (China direct exports), AI trade skyrocketing
risks.catalyst: McKinsey Geometry of Trade report (Mar 26), ongoing US-China tech decoupling
risks.detail: Supply chain inflation sticky, winners (Vietnam, India, Mexico) vs losers (China direct exports), AI trade skyrocketing

risks.label: Emerging Market Stress
risks.impact: EEM -3.40%, India rupee at record lows, FII outflows accelerating, oil-importing EM most vulnerable
risks.catalyst: India Sensex -2.5% weekly, rupee record lows. KOSPI -3.0%. Oil-importing EMs face higher energy costs + capital flight. EEM ETF crushed.
risks.detail: EEM -3.40%, India rupee at record lows, FII outflows accelerating, oil-importing EM most vulnerable

watchlist.thesis: Gold supercycle buy-the-dip after correction. $4,453/oz, structural bid intact with VIX elevated and dollar weak.
Energy only sector in green. Direct hedge against Iran/Hormuz risk. Brent above $100 = elevated earnings.
AI chip pivot confirmed. Needham upgrade to Buy ($200 PT). Barclays OW $165. Momentum post-reveal.
Long-duration bonds as recession hedge. At $86.11, yields at 4.94% on 30Y. Risk/reward improves if PCE cools.
Correction short. Below 50d and 200d MA. Next support $560. Rising yields hostile to high-PE tech.
At $68.5K, testing 200d MA ($66K). Break below confirms bear market. High correlation with SPX (0.72).

events.label: Q1 End — Window Dressing + Rebalancing
events.detail: Q1 penultimate day. Portfolio managers window-dress with energy outperformers. Elevated volume expected on BTU, VLO, LNG.

events.label: Q1 Final Day + Consumer Confidence
events.detail: Q1 close + Conference Board Consumer Confidence (10AM ET). Weak reading = defensive rotation accelerates.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Apr 1)
events.detail: Critical stagflation gauge. Sub-50 reading confirms oil-driven slowdown and boosts defensives.

events.label: ADP Employment + OPEC+ Monitor (Apr 2)
events.detail: ADP payrolls 8:15AM ET. OPEC+ may announce emergency output increase — watch oil price reaction.

events.label: Non-Farm Payrolls (Apr 3)
events.detail: Strong NFP = higher-for-longer rates. Weak NFP = recession fears. Either scenario supports energy and defensives.

opportunities.label: Energy Sector — Q1 Window Dressing
opportunities.detail: Portfolio managers showing energy exposure at quarter-end. BTU, VLO, LNG, EQNR historically see elevated buying pressure in final 2 days of Q1.

opportunities.label: US LNG — Marginal Supply Source for Europe/Asia
opportunities.detail: Persian Gulf gas stranded behind Hormuz blockade. JPMorgan raised LNG target to $279 (pre-escalation). Supply inelasticity = structural premium.

opportunities.label: Gold Miners — Lagging Metal (Catch-Up Trade)
opportunities.detail: Gold at $4,521. Miners systematically lagging the metal. Catch-up potential when momentum resumes. GDX/NEM positioned for mean reversion.
